_note: Editorial choices for the FIN-T1-003 story demo. Everything else in fin-story.json is extracted from run records by build_story_data.py. English lines are translations of the Chinese sources.
title_question: Can an AI agent review a month-end close?
title_question_zh: AI agent 能做月结复核吗？
closing_question: Can your agent close the books?

D01.title_en: Keep the HR-01 swap in the cash-flow hedge reserve under the original relationship

D02.title_en: Book the HR-03 USD loan's July FX loss to the cash-flow hedge reserve

D03.title_en: On termination, release HR-01's opening reserve to profit or loss at once

D04.title_en: HKSub June comparatives: fix rounding only and park the gap in translation differences

D05.title_en: Accrue a USSub disposal gain in July at 15/70 of the cumulative translation difference

D06.title_en: Replace the adopted IRS-2026-0031 value with the counterparty's and call the whole gap CVA

grouping_rule: Each criterion is grouped under the entry whose object (HR-01, HR-03, HKSub, USSub, IRS-2026-0031) or entry number it names; criteria about the whole close are listed as 'across the close'.

decision_en.D01: Rejects the entry and drafts a replacement
decision_en.D02: Accepts it as a provisional treatment, re-labelled to the net-investment hedge reserve
decision_en.D05: Rejects a July entry; rehearses the sale only
